sources.label: Table 1 · mean of five reported accuracies

notes: The hero reuses the accuracy-versus-client-parameters design of the archived avg_res.png asset, whose figure block is commented out in the saved v3 TeX. Its exact coordinates are recomputed from the public v3 Table 1; the unused graphic is not treated as public numerical evidence.
All five classification tasks in Table 1 at N=100 are included with equal weight: COCO-QA, T4SA, Kinetics-Sounds, UCF101 and MELD. No retrieval tasks are mixed into this mean.

Mean accuracy = arithmetic sum of the five printed percentage accuracies / 5. Scores are raw accuracies, not centralized-normalized scores. Source precision is retained in the input arrays and the derived means are displayed to two decimal places.

Table 1 reports each task as a mean over three seeds with a ± term, but the paper does not define whether that term is SD, SE or a confidence interval. These exact terms are retained in the supporting table and audit inputs.

No aggregate uncertainty is reported in Table 1, and covariance or seed-level joint values are unavailable. No error bars are manufactured by averaging or propagating task uncertainties. The archived aggregate graphic has no exact error-bar values in the saved source.
The source reports average client trainable parameters and GFLOPs per input. These are client costs, not total client-plus-server computation or measured latency.

The compact supporting table selects COCO-QA and MELD to expose one deficit and one gain, and retains Centralized, FedAvg, FedCLIP and MPSL plus client GFLOPs. The full five-task values underlying the hero remain recorded below.
